senses.gloss: f. (preced.) repetition, verbal teaching by repeated recitation; traditional law, opp. to מִקְרָא.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:7">Ab. III, 7</cite> <he>מפסיק ממִשְׁנָתוֹ</he> interrupts his study.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>כל השוכח … ממשנתו</he> he who forgets one word of what he has learned. <he>תקפה עליו משנתו</he> his study was too hard for him.

Erub. 54ᵇ כיצד סדר (ה)מ׳ what was the order of delivery of the oral law? Ber. 5ᵃ (ref. to Ex. XXIV, 12) התורה … והמצוה זו מ׳ ‘Torah’ means the Pentateuch, ‘Mitsvah’, the oral law; a. fr.—Esp. Mishnah, a collection of oral laws, esp. that edited by R. Judah han-Nasi; also a section of the Mishnah.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:10">Esth. R. to I, 2</cite>, a. fr. <he>ששה סדרי מ׳</he> the six Orders of the Mishnah; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:4:2">Cant. R. to VI, 4</cite>; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 7ᵃ, sq. <he>ערכי המ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P01377"><he>עֵרֶךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 91a:4">Ned. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ ראשונה</he> the earliest collection, <he>מ׳ שניה</he> the second edition.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:4:1">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:1:1">Y. Ter. VIII, beg. 45ᵃ</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 3:3:2">Y. Yeb. III, 4ᵈ</cite>, a. e. <he>אבי המ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00288"><he>הוֹשַׁעְיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:5:12">Y. Hor. III, end, 48ᶜ</cite> <he>מִשְׁנָתוֹ של וכ׳</he> the collection made by &c.—
Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵇ bot. ולא מ׳ עשיתי did I not follow the law of the Mishnah?; ib. וזו מִשְׁנַת החסידים but is this the mishnah of the pious (who must act kindlier than the strict law demands)?—
Erub. 62ᵇ, a. fr. משנת ר׳ … קב ונקי the opinions of R … recorded in collections are merely a ḳab (few) but pure (incontestable); a. fr.—Pl. מִשְׁנָיוֹת. Y. Hor. l. c. מ׳ גדולות the large collections.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>שיקע … רוב מ׳</he> Rabbi embodied (in his collection) most of the collections (of his predecessors); a. fr.
